english.title: Unauthorised person use / cause to be used pedal cycle etc. within Blackwall / Silvertown Tunnel areas

english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 7(2) of the Blackwall and Silvertown Tunnels Byelaws 2018 and article 48(6) of the Silvertown Tunnel Order 2018.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
not being an authorised person
used / caused to be used
a pedal cycle / electrically assisted pedal cycle / tricycle / barrow / cart / buggy / pedicab / rickshaw / vehicle used as a personal transporter / human drawn means of conveyance / animal drawn means of conveyance
within the Blackwall / Silvertown Tunnel area

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: except if it is conveyed as the load or part of the load of a motor vehicle.
